overview.summary: Trellis UI Tier 1 slice: the shadcn porting pipeline and `trellis_ui` package, 20 components and 4 layout primitives through a headless qualification gate, strict-CSP scaffolds with a `--ui` option, an admin example, component docs, and the first upstream sync; stories execute in trellis-public on the 0.14 branch, cut after 0.13 merges.

sharedDecisions.title: Component layout and gallery
sharedDecisions.description: S01 defines where each component's fragment file, hand CSS, behaviour JS and gallery page live inside `trellis_ui`, and a gallery server that serves one page per component under the strict policy (`script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'`). S04 and S05 add components only through that layout and gallery; S07's live examples render the same fragments; S08's sync gates and full gate run target the same gallery pages.

sharedDecisions.title: Harness input and gate record
sharedDecisions.description: S02's harness takes a base URL plus component page paths and per-component interaction scripts, never package internals, so it runs against S01's gallery or any page served under the strict policy. S02 also defines the per-component gate record: every FR5 item with its result and evidence, the screen-reader and Safari items marked for release prep. S04 and S05 write their components' records; S07 gives a reference page only to components whose automated items all pass; S08 completes the records and the release-prep checklist.

sharedDecisions.title: CSP violation capture in the browser probe
sharedDecisions.description: S02 and S03 both need strict-CSP violation capture in headless Chrome and run in parallel. The capture lives in `test/browser_reflow_probe.dart`, armed before page scripts run, and S02's is the one kept: S03 keeps its addition in one self-contained block and, if it merges after S02, deletes that block and uses S02's. S01's gallery self-reports violations through a same-origin script and needs neither.

sharedDecisions.title: Gallery shell and gate command
sharedDecisions.description: S01's gallery shell loads self-hosted htmx 2.0.10 with `allowEval: false` and `includeIndicatorStyles: false` and links `/trellis-ui/htmx-indicator.css`, and `tool/gallery.dart --port 0` prints `Serving <base-url>` as its first stdout line. S02's `tool/ui_gate.dart --serve '<command>'` starts such a server, reads that line, runs and stops it. S04, S05 and S08 run the gate through that command; no story adds a second gate wrapper or a second htmx copy in the gallery.

sharedDecisions.title: Pinned shadcn tag
sharedDecisions.description: S01 pins `shadcn@4.21.1`, the spike's last verified tag, and S04 and S05 vendor their components at that same pin. S08 is the only story that moves the pin, to the newest stable tag at execution, so 0.14 carries one real upstream sync.

sharedDecisions.title: Full-gate tests run locally
sharedDecisions.description: A test that runs the full gate over real pages carries the `ui-gate` tag, and one that compares a per-OS visual baseline carries `visual`; both are excluded from CI's tiers and run in the release-gate tier on the maintainer's macOS machine, as the existing `visual` tier is (ADR-012: gates run locally). S02 registers the `ui-gate` tag and documents it in `KEY_DEVELOPMENT_COMMANDS.md`; S04, S05 and S08 tag their gate runs. Harness and record unit tests on fixtures without an OS baseline stay in the fast tier.

stories.name: Porting pipeline and trellis_ui package

verified.summary: melos exec --dir-exists=test -- dart test --exclude-tags=e2e -> exit=0, [trellis_ui]: 00:04 +27: All tests passed!

stories.scope: Bring the O6 spike's porting pipeline into trellis-public and ship the `trellis_ui` package that delivers its output. Pipeline: pinned shadcn inputs vendored with their notices, `cn-` to `trellis-` generation compiled by the pinned, checksummed Tailwind standalone CLI, the regeneration gate, the structural-class report and reasoned parity-ignore entries. Its first step settles Tailwind-preflight isolation against FR4's isolation fixture; isolation is not relaxed, so if preflight resets cannot be scoped to suite elements the run stops for an owner decision. Package: fragments and assets embedded with digests, rendered through the app's engine, served same-origin under `/trellis-ui/` for Shelf, Relic and Dart Frog apps, optional materialization, and registration in the lockstep set. Proven end to end on the button and a per-component gallery served under the strict policy; the button's qualification is S05's. Starting code: trellis-private branch `spike/trellis-ui-o6-shadcn-port`, directory `docs/temp/trellis-ui-o6-shadcn-spike/`.

stories.name: Headless qualification harness

verified.summary: dart test --exclude-tags=visual --exclude-tags=ui-gate -> exit=0, 02:53 +238 ~2: All tests passed!

stories.scope: The automated half of ADR-012's qualification gate as a committed, Node-free tool driving headless Chrome and headless Firefox per component page: strict-CSP violation capture, vendored axe-core at WCAG 2.2 A/AA, scripted APG keyboard walks, emulated forced colours, zoom and reduced motion, the 390/768/1440 widths, touch-target measurement under an emulated coarse pointer, and HTMX swap and history-restore lifecycle checks. Adds the per-state computed-style capture (extending the repo's visual-baseline digest to forced states) that serves the gate's visual item and S08's appearance check, proven by replaying the spike's three screenshot-only regressions; a state whose regression it misses gets a pixel diff. Writes the per-component gate record. The repo drives Chrome over raw DevTools protocol (`test/browser_reflow_probe.dart`) while the spike used `package:puppeteer`; align with one and say why. Proven on fixture pages that pass and fail. Starting code: the spike's `tool/check.dart` and `tool/webdriver.dart` on trellis-private branch `spike/trellis-ui-o6-shadcn-port`.

stories.name: Strict-CSP scaffolds and dev reload

verified.summary: dart test packages/trellis_cli/test/generated_app_e2e_test.dart packages/trellis_cli/test/relic_e2e_test.dart packages/trellis_cli/test/dart_frog_e2e_test.dart -> exit=0, 00:05 +23: All tests passed!

stories.scope: Projects from all three app scaffolds load with 0 violations under the strict policy: htmx self-hosted by default with a CDN opt-in whose CSP allows exactly that origin, the CSRF script as a same-origin file, htmx indicator styles off with a same-origin indicator stylesheet (TD-018), and a strict preset in the security-headers builders (Shelf's `CspBuilder`, which Dart Frog reuses, and Relic's own copy; TD-017). Dev mode reloads the browser on static CSS/JS changes in the Shelf and Dart Frog scaffolds, with the reload client moved from an injected inline script to a same-origin script; Relic's missing browser reload goes to tech debt. The `--ui` flag is S06's.
stories.sequencing: Needs neither the 0.13 primitives nor `trellis_ui`, so it can start before 0.13 merges.

stories.name: Behaviour components

verified.summary: dart test test/qualification_gate_test.dart --plain-name "automated qualification remains green in Chrome and Firefox" -> exit=0, 25 component records regenerated byte for byte

stories.scope: Dialog (including alert dialog), dropdown menu, HTMX-populated combobox, toast (in-page and out-of-band from one definition) and tabs as fragments wrapped in light-DOM custom elements in the one classic script, reproducing the Base UI `data-*` contract the vega CSS selects on, with the shared CSSOM positioning fallback. Each passes every automated gate item and gets its gate record; owned JS stays within the 400-line release gate. Starting code: the spike's `ui/js/` and `templates/components/` for dropdown, tabs, toast and combobox; dialog is new.
stories.sequencing: Runs after S05 (owner, 2026-10-21): the behaviour components reuse its button, input, field and touch layer, and the two stories would otherwise edit the same generated files, README table and record tests.

stories.name: CSS-only components, layout primitives and overrides

verified.summary: cd packages/trellis_ui && dart test test/qualification_gate_test.dart -> exit=0, 11:46 +1: All tests passed!

stories.scope: The 15 CSS-only components (the button S01 delivers, plus input, textarea, field/label, native select, checkbox, radio, switch, badge, card, alert, table, pagination, breadcrumb, separator), the four Trellis-authored layout primitives (stack, cluster, grid, container/sidebar), the touch-target layer and the destructive-colour contrast override, all through the public styling surface. Each component passes every automated gate item and gets its gate record, the button included.

stories.name: Admin example, UI scaffold option and preview assets

verified.summary: dart test --exclude-tags=visual --exclude-tags=ui-gate -> exit=0, 04:55 +252 ~2: All tests passed!

stories.scope: A new records app under `examples/` built from suite fragments and tokens only, covering every FR7 screen and interaction under the strict preset, within the 50-line app-CSS gate with 0 component JS, and serving all assets as an AOT binary moved away from the repo; `todo_app` stays unchanged. The pasted shadcn theme block check (US04) runs against it. `trellis create --ui` for the Shelf, Relic and Dart Frog scaffolds adds `trellis_ui` and an example page that renders with 0 manual steps. Preview assets land in each scaffold's gitignored preview folder, written at dev start in the Shelf and Dart Frog scaffolds and by an on-demand command in all three; the AOT `trellis` CLI cannot read package assets (ADR-012), so that command runs from the app's own `trellis_ui` dependency.

stories.name: Component reference docs and docs-site seam

verified.summary: dart test --exclude-tags=visual --exclude-tags=ui-gate -> exit=0, 04:00 +264 ~2: All tests passed!

stories.scope: The generic `trellis_site` hook for extra fragment sources and static assets, wired to `trellis_ui` by `trellis_cli` when a site or theme opts in; one docs-site reference page per component whose automated gate items all pass, each rendering a live `trellis_ui` example with the facts FR8 lists; and the guide for adding `trellis_ui` to an existing app, theming with a shadcn theme block, and the `cn-` to `trellis-` mapping. The docs site deploys under the `/trellis/` path prefix, so suite asset links must honour it.

stories.name: First upstream sync and full gate run

verified.summary: dart test test/qualification_gate_test.dart --reporter expanded -> exit=0, 17:03 +1: All tests passed!

stories.scope: The sync skill and its scripts in trellis-public, run once end to end: bump the pinned shadcn tag, regenerate, run slot parity, the S02 harness, the per-state computed-style appearance check with its token diff, and the regeneration gate; triage each upstream change, flag breaking hook renames, and commit the sync report with every failure fixed or triaged. Then run the full automated gate across all components, the admin example and the three scaffolds, measure the payload and JS-line release gates, and leave the release-prep items (screen-reader passes on both matrix pairs, the Safari pass, the sync-report review) recorded in the gate records. Starting point: the spike's `tool/port.dart` sync commands and its `reports/sync-*.md`.
stories.sequencing: S06 and S07 come first so the full gate run covers the admin example and the final component markup the docs render.

stories.name: Suite components in site themes
stories.scope: Through S07's `trellis_site` hook, themes adopt a suite search combobox over one `trellis_site` search client with one hook (TD-021, replacing the per-theme `search.js` copies in arbor, folio and lattice), the reader dark/light toggle in lattice, folio and meadow, and arbor's code-block copy button. Suite assets ship only with themes that use a component and cause 0 violations under the strict policy; the themes' inline anti-FOUC script (TD-023) stays out. Cut first if 0.14 runs long; no other story depends on it.
